answer: Commit-reveal grading stops a sybil ring from echoing one another's verdicts. Step one: each grader hashes its score with a secret salt and locks that hash in an on-chain vault. Step two: only after the commit window shuts do graders reveal score and salt. Step three: the ledger checks every reveal against its hash and slashes any mismatch. Step four: a score far from the honest median burns a 50 POA stake. A ring of 200 fakes can't whisper answers mid-round, so it gambles 10,000 POA each epoch on blind guesses. It's an orchard where every picker seals their basket before anyone peeks.
